about: A started post-login activity does two things. At sign-in it asks the people it reaches — the members of its groups, or everybody in the realm — to do the activity, under the rules of the post-login profile that reaches each person on Directory → Policies, even where that profile is switched off. By mail, a scheduler job reads each running activity's people a slice at a time, about every {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, and mails the people the activity is due for a reminder to sign in — never twice within the reminder interval, and never more than the activity's maximum. The mail's one link opens the sign-in page; it carries no credential.
noMail: No mail transport is configured in this realm, so a running post-login activity mails nobody. Set one up on Server configuration → Mail.
signIn: While an activity is running, the people it reaches are asked at their next sign-in. A named post-login profile that reaches a person and is switched off excludes them, as it does from the policy — one their group names excludes them from the mail too, one the application they sign in to names only at that sign-in; the default profile being off excludes nobody. Paused or ended, an activity asks nobody at sign-in and mails nobody; a person the policy itself switches on is still asked.
reportLink: Who was mailed, and where each person stands: the postLoginProgress report
none: No post-login activity has been started in this realm.
numbers: every {interval, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, at most {max} per person, {perRun} people a run
done: {passes, plural, one {# pass} other {# passes}}, {read} read, {mailed} mailed, {refused} refused
groupsHint: Search for groups and pick one or more results to build the list. The activity asks the members of every group on the list at sign-in and mails them, each person once; with no group, everybody in the realm.
noGroups: No group chosen: the activity reaches everybody in the realm.
findPlaceholder: part of a group's name or DN
groupsFull: {max} groups are chosen, the most one activity may name.
startNote: Starting it asks the people it reaches from their next sign-in; mailing starts at the job's next run. A person who has done the activity, whom the realm cannot ask, or whom a named post-login profile switched off excludes, is neither asked nor mailed.
readOnly: Starting, pausing and ending a post-login activity needs Admin Write.
